summary.bn: মাটি কতটা ভেজা তা পড়ে: AO-তে ভোল্টেজ, আর বেশি ভেজা হলে DO LOW।
summary.en: Reads how wet the soil is: a voltage on AO, and DO LOW once the soil is wetter than the trimmer is set for.

simplified: How far AO falls for a given moisture is an estimate. In real soil it depends on the soil, how packed it is and what is dissolved in the water.
The fork is drawn as part of the module; on the real one it is a separate probe on two wires.
The fork does not corrode. A real one does, quickly, when left powered in wet soil; that is why projects often power it only while reading.
Its comparator switches cleanly at the trimmer's setting. A real one flickers when the reading sits right at that point.
The resistances inside the module are estimates; no schematic of the kit's module has been seen.
The comparator and the two indicator lights draw a few milliamps that are not counted.
